79631.subject: 🔷 The Daily:'BTC still has room to catch up'
79631.body:

Check out thelatent.co ( https://thelatent.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) and sign up for The Latent Daily newsletter ( https://thelatent.co/newsletter?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) to stay on top of the biggest developments in AI.

*Bitcoin* ( https://www.theblock.co/price/bitcoin?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) is holding above $84,000, with K33 saying BTC still has room to catch up ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-09-23-bitcoin-breakout-etf-inflows-analysts-k33-nexo-resistance-416182?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ). Chainalysis, meanwhile, estimates the crypto economy ( https://www.theblock.co/news/ecosystems/2026-09-23-crypto-economy-fell-just-1-6-in-12-months-despite-2-1-trillion-market-cap-rout-chainalysis-says-416150?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) contracted just 1.6% over the past year despite a $2.1 trillion decline in market capitalization.

Tokenization is moving further into traditional finance. Blockchain.com and NYSE ( https://www.theblock.co/news/web3/2026-09-23-blockchain-com-nyse-tokenized-us-stocks-etfs-416176?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) plan to give Blockchain.com users access to tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, while Canada's six largest banks ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-09-23-canada-banks-tokenized-deposit-system-416129?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) are exploring a tokenized deposit system for payments.
